recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片大部分是中型原始細胞：胞質少、染色質細緻，許多核輪廓不規則或有凹陷，偶見淡藍胞質邊緣，只殘存少數中性球前驅細胞與有核紅血球；這種單一形態原始細胞片狀取代符合 T 淋巴母細胞白血病（需流式確認）。
features: Sheets of medium-sized blasts replacing the marrow
High N:C ratio with scant pale to moderately basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Round to irregular, occasionally indented or convoluted nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Residual myelocyte, occasional larger myeloid cells and dense erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows diffuse replacement by a relatively monotonous population of medium-sized blasts with scant agranular cytoplasm, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and frequently irregular or indented nuclear contours. Residual granulocytic precursors and erythroid precursors are sparse. No Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; T-lymphoblastic lineage should be confirmed by flow cytometry (cytoplasmic CD3, CD7, CD1a, TdT).

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps completely; B-lineage markers (CD19, CD79a, PAX5) rather than cytoplasmic CD3 separate them.
Myeloblasts are MPO/CD117/CD13/CD33 positive and cCD3 negative despite similar agranular appearance.
ETP-ALL looks the same but is CD1a and CD8 negative with weak CD5 and expresses stem/myeloid markers, requiring flow cytometry.
